0022600214.text: The Miami Heat (4-6, 8th in the East) visit the Utah Jazz (1-9, 15th in the West) on a three-game... no, the Heat are on a one-game winning streak and sit 2 games back in the Southeast, with a 3-3 road record. Miami is without Giannis Antetokounmpo, who is day-to-day with a wrist sprain and a game-time decision, and he averages 27.5 points and 32.8 minutes per game this season. Utah will be missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), Keyonte George (ankle sprain), and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain), all listed as out, and the teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, which was split 1-1 in 2025-26, with the last meeting on February 9, 2026 in Miami, a 115-111 Heat loss.
